title: fix(plugin-map): prescribe a map style spelling the runtime actually reads
body:
Fixes #10002

Clause-②: no — a dev-warning string and its pins. It moves no exported symbol and no key on a published payload.

## The sentence, old and new

`warnOnTopLevelStyleUrl` fires when a map node carries a string `style` — the base schema's inline-CSS key, never read as a map style — and tells the author where to write it instead. Only the LAST sentence moved. Both readings below were derived from the file's own bytes (the `console.warn` argument evaluated with a literal URL), ⛔ not retyped:

**OLD**

> On a view, note that `options.map` is FLATTENED into the top level, so its `style` lands here as this same top-level key — spell it `map: { mapStyle }` there. objectui#5017.

**NEW**

> On a view, write that same declared `map: { style: ... }`: ObjectView / ListView flatten `options.map` through a whitelist of the keys `ObjectMapConfigSchema` declares, and that whitelist carries `style` out under the flat spelling `mapStyle` (objectui#9950), so the declared block arrives and is read. `mapStyle` is the TOP-LEVEL spelling only — inside the `map` block it is undeclared, and the flatten drops it. objectui#5017.

The diagnosis is untouched, deliberately: the top-level-`style` collision it reports is real and is why the flatten whitelist exists. What was wrong was the PRESCRIPTION.

## The end-to-end measurement that proves the new spelling is carried

⚠️ Written from what was MEASURED, not from what the schema declares. Each cell is a real render — the key written into a real `map` block, read off the `mapStyle` prop the mocked MapGL receives:

| written as | directly authored node | through the real `ListView` flatten |
|---|---|---|
| `map: { style: 'URL' }` | arrives | arrives |
| `map: { mapStyle: 'URL' }` (the old remedy) | dropped, demo tiles | dropped, demo tiles |

Why the declared spelling now works, on the view path where the old text said it could not: since objectui#9950 both flatteners copy each declared key under a flat SPELLING, and `style`'s is `mapStyle` — so a view's `map: { style }` arrives as a top-level `mapStyle`, which `getMapConfig` reads. The old sentence was still describing the pre-#9950 transport, which is why it was wrong twice: wrong key, and a premise that had expired.

## Premise re-checked on the tree, not on the card

Three legs, each with a same-command control:

- `ObjectMapConfigSchema` declares `style` and does NOT declare `mapStyle` — counted inside the extracted block: `style` 1, `mapStyle` 0, the live `style` hit being the control that makes the zero a reading.
- `getMapConfig` reads the style as `schema.mapStyle || schema.map?.style` — no `schema.map?.mapStyle` anywhere.
- Producers of an `object-map` node: exactly two, `ObjectView` and `ListView`; neither `baseProps` carries `style`, so since objectui#9950 neither emits a top-level `style` at all. The warning stays reachable from a node authored (or host-composed) with a string `style` written directly on it — the shape its own tests exercise.

## The pin, and why it is not a string snapshot

A warning whose text nothing executes is how this one rotted, so the new pin does not compare the sentence to a literal. `ObjectMap.styleRemedyText-10002.test.tsx` renders the component, takes the warning it really emits, PARSES every key the sentence prescribes inside a `map` block out of it, then writes that key into a real `map` block and measures whether it reaches MapGL — through the declared block and through the real `ListView`. It carries its own controls: a leg asserting the sentence prescribes at least one key (so a remedy that stopped prescribing anything cannot pass vacuously), and a leg measuring that `map: { mapStyle }` is dropped on both paths (so the measurement is shown to discriminate).

⇒ the sentence and the runtime cannot drift apart again without a test going red. Demonstrated in three directions:

| what was broken | result |
|---|---|
| the OLD sentence, on the unmodified tree (blob equal to the base commit's, verified in the same command as the run) | RED — `{ style: true, mapStyle: false }` against the expected all-true |
| producer: the `ListView` whitelist stops giving `style` its flat spelling | RED, 2 failed |
| consumer: BOTH of `getMapConfig`'s reads of the declared block's `style` cut | RED, 2 failed |

Every mutation was proven to land and proven to be restored by object hash against the committed blob plus a marker count, ⛔ never by an exit code; each ablation script carried a `trap` restoring absolute paths. The mutations are seen without a build: the root vitest config aliases `@object-ui/plugin-list` to that package's `src`, and the component is imported relatively.

The pre-existing pin, `ObjectMap.topLevelStyle.test.tsx`, asserted a phrase out of this same sentence. That assertion is retired in favour of the executed one, and the block's prose — which described the pre-objectui#9950 raw-bag flatten, and told the next reader that `map: { mapStyle }` flattens to a top-level `mapStyle` — is corrected to the measured transport. Its behavioural assertions are unchanged.

## Verification

Run on the pushed commit, with the tree verified equal to it and nothing unstaged in the same command.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-map/` — exit 0, 24 files, 141 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-map type-check` — exit 0. Both test files are really in that program (counted with `tsc --listFiles`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-map lint` — exit 0 (warnings only, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any` of this package's test convention).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — decided by running it, ⛔ not from memory: it asked for one, and `@object-ui/plugin-map` is published and this string ships in the tarball, so the declaration is a real `patch`, not an empty frontmatter. Exit 0 with it.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:shell-escape-residue` — all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:sdui-registration-pins` — exit 2, a stated prerequisite (it needs a console bundle this fresh worktree has not built), not a red. No shipped registration moved in this diff. Left to CI.
- The repo-wide lint and the full suite are CI's runs, not this seat's.

## Acceptance notes

Seat session, in prose and as a code span because a later edit of this body downgrades the footer: `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`.

- Noted, not filed: `getMapConfig` reads the declared block's `style` through TWO independent paths — the `style` variable's own arm, and `config.style || style` in the block branch — so cutting either one alone is behaviourally invisible. Measured twice while ablating, both greens. Not a defect (the behaviour is correct and the redundancy is harmless), and no card: the only one it can mislead is a future seat single-point-ablating that function and reading a false green, which is why it is written down here rather than filed. Successor: none identified.
